oids.description: Image of the back of the device.

oids.description: Version of the software loaded on the PDU.

oids.description: Machine type of the PDU.

oids.description: Model number of the PDU.

oids.description: Part number of the PDU.

oids.description: Name of the device.

oids.description: The name of manufacturer.

oids.description: Serial number of the device.

oids.description: Description of the device.

oids.description: URL of the web interface to the ibmDevice if available.

oids.description: Set 1 to reboot PDU.

oids.name: ibmPduDateTime
oids.description: Set or get PDU Date and Time.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletCount
oids.description: The number of outlets (regardless of their current state) present on this PDU.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletName
oids.description: Text describing the name or designation of the given outlet.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletType
oids.description: Type of the outlet.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletDescription
oids.description: Description of the outlet.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletAvgPower
oids.description: Buffer containing average power values. Refer to description of IbmPduPowerBuf for information about buffer format.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletMaxPower
oids.description: Buffer containing max power values. Refer to description of IbmPduPowerBuf for information about buffer format.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletPowerFactor
oids.description: The value of the Power Factor of the given outlet.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletVoltage
oids.description: The value of the Voltage of the given outlet returned in MilliVolt.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletCurrent
oids.description: The value of the Current of the given outlet returned in Milliamps.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletMaxCapacity
oids.description: The maximum capacity of the current outlet in Milliamps.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletCurrentThresholdWarning
oids.description: The value of the warning threshold for the given outlet returned in Milliamps.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletCurrentThresholdCritical
oids.description: The value of the critical threshold for the given outlet returned in Milliamps.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletState
oids.description: The value of the operational state for the given outlet. This can also be used to set (change) the outlet state.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletGroupIndex
oids.description: The index of the outlet group in which the outlet resides. If there are no outlet groups present, the default is 0.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletLastPowerReading
oids.description: The value of the most recent power reading for this outlet, in Watts.

oids.name: ibmPduOutletIndividualDelayTimer
oids.description: The delay timer for each outlet as AC power restored. Range: 0 sec ~ 3600 sec. Default Value: 0 sec. To combine with Global Delay timer to control outlet state/behavior as rack power or or restore

oids.name: ibmPduOutletGlobalDelayTimer
oids.description: Global delay timer for all outlets. Range: 0 sec ~ 3600 sec. Default value:0 sec. To combine with Individual Delay timer to control outlet state/behavior as rack power on/restore

oids.name: ibmPduPhaseCount
oids.description: The number of input power phases for the PDU.

oids.name: ibmPduPhaseAvgPower
oids.description: Buffer containing average power values. Refer to description of IbmPduPowerBuf for information about buffer format.

oids.name: ibmPduPhaseMaxPower
oids.description: Buffer containing max power values. Refer to description of IbmPduPowerBuf for information about buffer format.

oids.name: ibmPduPhaseLastPowerReading
oids.description: The value of the most recent power reading for this phase, in Watts.

oids.name: ibmPduThermalBuffer
oids.description: Buffer that contains the thermal records. Refer to description of IbmPduEnvBuf for information about buffer format.

oids.name: ibmPduHumidityBuffer
oids.description: Buffer that contains the humdity records. Refer to description of IbmPduEnvBuf for information about buffer format.

oids.name: ibmPduThermalThresholdWarning
oids.description: The value of the warning threshold for the given temperature returned in Celsius.

oids.name: ibmPduThermalThresholdCritical
oids.description: The value of the critical threshold for the given temperature returned in Celsius.

oids.name: ibmPduHumidityThresholdWarning
oids.description: The value of the warning threshold for the given humidity returned as a percent.

oids.name: ibmPduHumidityThresholdCritical
oids.description: The value of the critical threshold for the given humidity returned as a percent.

oids.name: ibmPduThermalLastReading
oids.description: The value of the most recent temperature reading for the internal temperature sensor, in degrees Celsius.

oids.name: ibmPduHumidityLastReading
oids.description: The value of the most recent humidity reading for the internal humidity sensor, as a percentage.

oids.name: ibmPduExtMonitorCount
oids.description: The number of external monitors (regardless of their current state) present on this PDU.

oids.name: ibmPduExtThermalBuffer
oids.description: Buffer that contains the thermal records. Refer to description of IbmPduEnvBuf for information about buffer format.

oids.name: ibmPduExtHumidityBuffer
oids.description: Buffer that contains the humdity records. Refer to description of IbmPduEnvBuf for information about buffer format.

oids.name: ibmPduExtThermalThresholdWarning
oids.description: The value of the warning threshold for the given temperature returned in Celsius.

oids.name: ibmPduExtThermalThresholdCritical
oids.description: The value of the critical threshold for the given temperature returned in Celsius.

oids.name: ibmPduExtHumidityThresholdWarning
oids.description: The value of the warning threshold for the given humidity returned as a percent.

oids.name: ibmPduExtHumidityThresholdCritical
oids.description: The value of the critical threshold for the given humidity returned as a percent.

oids.name: ibmPduExtThermalLastReading
oids.description: The value of the most recent temperature reading for the external temperature sensor, in degrees Celsius. If no external temperature sensor is connected, a value of -1 should be returned.

oids.name: ibmPduExtHumidityLastReading
oids.description: The value of the most recent humidity reading for the external humidity sensor, as a percentage. If no external humidity sensor is connected, a value of -1 should be returned.
